description: This file contains system and hardware initialization routines for the NXP LPC55S69 platform, including clock setup, peripheral configuration, and secondary core boot procedures.

methods.name: clock_init
methods.description: Initializes system clocks, PLLs, and peripheral clocks based on platform configuration.

methods.name: nxp_lpc55xxx_init
methods.description: Performs basic hardware initialization, including clock setup and peripheral initialization.

methods.name: z_arm_platform_init
methods.description: Platform-specific initialization, disables trace clock if not using SWO.

methods.name: _second_core_init
methods.description: Boots the secondary core in multi-core configurations.
